title: MigrationPlan
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a definition of the migration strategy and execution plan for transitioning from baseline to target architecture. A governance definition of change execution. Rootless, domain-scoped. TOGAF mapping: Migration Plan (ADM Phase F, Migration Planning). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Phase F).

migrationStrategy.description: Migration execution strategy. BIG_BANG = single cutover. PHASED = incremental transitions. PARALLEL_RUN = old and new running simultaneously. STRANGLER_FIG = progressive replacement. TOGAF mapping: Migration Planning strategy.

riskLevel.description: Assessed migration risk level. TOGAF mapping: Migration Planning risk assessment.

rollbackCapable.description: Whether the migration plan includes rollback capability. TOGAF mapping: Migration Planning reversibility assessment.
